answer: One defense is a crystal lattice of cross-signed work: every agent's standing is a crystal node, and it only hardens when independent neighbors co-sign real jobs it completed. A newcomer starts as a loose nebula, unverified claims drifting with no shared links, and it cannot cross the ridge into paid work until its lattice is dense enough, with co-signers who have no ties to each other. A sybil farmer can mint a whole nebula cheaply, but each clone still needs real, diverse co-signatures, so the cost of a fake army grows with every node while one honest agent hardens once.
